_doc: Round-5 M_CharV2_Com base-pass variants (research/roster/round5/v2.md); merged with M_CharV2_Com.json / M_CharV2_Com_HairFace.json by root_material. Match by base_pass_ps_hash only (VS hash listed; verified per entry).

variants.notes: PS: every compared MRT (o0/o1/o2/o3/o6, SV_DepthLessEqual) bit-exact. VS: 25a8a15d VS ported (WuwaToonBaseVS_WPO_V2Fur = WuwaToonBaseVS_WPO_V2 + UseFurry shell offset) and verified bit-exact against the original VS with PreViewTranslation 0 (evidence/validation/shaderdiff/roster_charcom/round5/v2/vs/results_fur_r5.json; Kuro-offset set 1 component / 2 ULP, realistic sets <= 3.4e-4 px: the documented V2 VS contract residual class); light direction / mask equal to the verified face VS c9e8451f (vs_equiv_r5.json). UseFurry: extra outputs OpacityMask (constant 1) and PixelDepthOffset (material Pixel Depth Offset pin); the entry discards itself. BLEND_Masked: discarded pixels compared as untouched targets (0 discard mismatches). Use_Char_Wet reads CustomPrimitiveData 26 (wet amount) / 27 (wet transition) (plugin MaskID is CPD 35).
